title: panel quorum-refute leg — attacks on the other legs' plans
description: Output contract of one quorum-refute panel leg: references/quorum/prompts/refute-plan.schema.json's critiques flattened into one items array, one entry per attack, each naming the plan it targets by payload label. A plan with nothing genuinely wrong simply has no entry. The classifier assigns item ids <lab>-<n> by position; provider labels reattach only at synthesis.

items.description: Every attack on every plan in the packet. Empty is a valid verdict — nothing genuinely wrong was found.

target.description: Which plan this attack addresses, by payload label.

where.description: The step or claim in the plan under attack.

what.description: The failure: what does not hold, is missing, or breaks when executed as written.

basis.description: The receipt: the brief line, pack fact, or plan step it rests on. 'Seems thin' is not a basis.
